thread:
kim: Heads up  drafting a concise manager + HR onboarding checklist for next week's hire. Keep Day 1 frictionless and set clear 30/60/90 outcomes. Add missing owners.

alexa: good plan. I'll book intro slots and pick a buddy.

kim: Checklist (paste for managers):
```
Pre-start (48h):
- IT: laptop + SSO + VPN request
- Slack invite + calendar blocks created
- Repo access requested (devex)
- Manager: schedule Week1 1:1 slots

Day 1:
- 9:00 welcome (People Ops) + paperwork
- 10:00 dev env setup (DevEx/IT)
- 11:00 team intros (15m each)
- Lunch with buddy
- 2:00 small starter task assigned + walkthrough
- EOD: 30m sync with manager (goals + expectations)

Week 1:
- Cross-team quick intros: Product, SRE, Security
- Product metrics & roadmap overview
- CI/CD + PR process walkthrough
- Merge first green PR or complete starter task

30/60/90 (examples):
- 30d: understand stack, merge 2 PRs, complete onboarding checklist
- 60d: own small feature or infra area, measurable improvement (perf/test coverage)
- 90d: lead a demo or rollout, document impact + next steps
```

kim: Owners: People Ops (welcome/docs), IT (hardware/accounts), DevEx (env/repos), Manager (mentor + goals), Security (data access).

it-bot: IT ticket #8890 created for newhire.sam: standard laptop + VPN. ETA 48 hours.

newhire.sam: Quick Q: who approves access to internal dataset for evals?

ryan: @newhire.sam Security approves with manager sign-off + NDA. Use https://internal.redwood.dev/sec/access-request and cc your manager.

devex: I'll share the onboarding repo and README and can run a remote devcontainer if hardware delayed: git.internal/redwood/onboard.

alexa: I'll set measurable acceptance criteria in the Week1 1:1. Example: 30d = 2 PRs merged + one doc update.

kim: Thanks all  I'll update the master template and push final invites once IT confirms provisioning.

newhire.sam: Appreciate it! :wave:
